slug: 2024-11-18 Telecom Egypt Regional Data Hub 2 awarded Tier III design certification

facts.fact: Telecom Egypt's press release states 13 submarine cable systems land on Egypt's eastern coast (no landing stations named), with plans to expand to 18.
facts.system: 13 submarine cable systems on Egypt's eastern coast

note: As_of is the release date; the document gives no earlier date for the count of 13. Planned expansion to 18 cables is not in service and not a fact.
